digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle enforcement and policy gates
propositions: Material-pin and plan-review enforcement policies must be enabled in rebar.toml while remaining disabled by default in the reusable configuration schema, and a legacy unpinned attestation must continue to pass both gates.
Unchanged successful re-review must produce no further downstream propagation, and direct material changes must trigger invalidation while code-only changes at close do not.

Depends_on and inbound blocks references must normalize to a single canonical prerequisite pin and evaluation, and execution-phase self-edits must invalidate close until a fresh execution review is performed.

Enable/disable/re-enable cycles, deleted/archived pinned target handling, concurrent review/close changes, and audited force-close must be provable through public lifecycle surfaces without eager backfill or graph-wide invalidation events.

Real CLI invocation with no dry-run bypass must enforce both policies with deterministic exit codes, status transitions, and user-visible remediation text for stale-pin-drift and incompatible-phase rejection cases.
No new pin command, stored relation migration, ordinary-list output change, or graph-wide invalidation event must be introduced during enforcement enablement.
